system: Coffee & A Joint Field Supply Monetization
operating_rule: No owner inventory, packing, shipping or customer fulfillment. Prefer direct manufacturer/dealer/retailer fulfillment with tracked referral revenue.
print_rule: Physical book and downloadable book use stable Field Supply IDs / coffeeandajoint.co destinations only. Do not freeze retailer affiliate URLs into print. Amazon Special Links are never placed in printed material or ebooks/PDFs.
routing_strategy: high-commission creator/affiliate program with vendor fulfillment
Amazon Associates fallback for commodity parts and supplies

partners.name: Seedburo Equipment Company
partners.public_terms: Seedburo is recruiting sales representatives and advertises competitive margins and partner support; exact margin is negotiated.
partners.human_gate: Review/accept rep agreement, territory, tax/payment onboarding if Seedburo approves.

partners.name: PITEBA
partners.public_terms: PITEBA sells direct worldwide and maintains a selected dealer network; no public referral percentage found.
partners.human_gate: Review/accept dealer/referral agreement and payout/tax onboarding if offered.

partners.name: Farmet a.s.
partners.public_terms: Farmet states that buyers can contact the manufacturer directly and that partners can become sales representatives; exact commercial terms are negotiated.
partners.human_gate: Review/accept sales-rep/referral agreement, territory and payout terms if offered.

partners.name: Lowe's Creator Program
partners.public_terms: Up to 25% commission depending on category; 30-day attribution window.

partners.name: The Home Depot Creator
partners.public_terms: Creator program advertises 8% on everything plus bonus opportunities. Separate legacy affiliate FAQ lists lower standard rates; prefer Creator program if accepted.

partners.name: Northern Tool + Equipment
partners.public_terms: 30-day cookie, 40,000+ online items, average order advertised above $234; program is run through CJ.
partners.human_gate: CJ publisher/application onboarding plus tax/payout setup.

partners.name: Tractor Supply Co.
partners.public_terms: Affiliate program advertises competitive monthly commissions and tracking/reporting; signup is routed through its performance-marketing partner.

partners.name: Amazon Associates
partners.public_terms: Standard US rate is currently 3% for Tools, Home Improvement, Lawn & Garden and Business & Industrial Supplies; normal session window is 24 hours.
restrictions: No Special Links in printed book or ebook/PDF.
Use Special Links only on approved online Sites / other permitted channels under current program policy.
Do not use Amazon as the default when a higher-value direct or specialty partner is available.
partners.human_gate: Associates application plus site review, identity/tax/payout setup.
